_meta.description: Vehicle-model spec database. Keyed by lowercase substring matched against vehicle_details.model; first match wins, unmatched models fall back to VEHICLE_GEOMETRY's vehicle_type bucket. mass_kg = cited kerb weight + operating-load allowance (+50kg rider for two-wheelers, +150kg for cars). See README.md.

scooty.source_notes: TVS Scooty Pep Plus. Kerb ~103kg + 50kg rider = 150kg. Wheelbase 1230mm.

himalayan.source_notes: Royal Enfield Himalayan. Kerb ~199kg + 50kg rider = 249kg. Wheelbase 1465-1510mm (1.51 used).

civic.source_notes: Honda Civic (2011 sedan). Kerb 1193-1222kg + 150kg, 1357kg midpoint. Wheelbase 2700mm.

dezire.source_notes: Maruti Swift Dzire. Kerb 960kg + 150kg = 1110kg. Wheelbase 2450mm. Keyed 'dezire' to match the real fleet spelling ('Swift dezire'), deliberately distinct from plain 'swift' (the lighter hatchback).

fz.source_notes: Yamaha FZ-S FI. Kerb 135kg + 50kg rider = 185kg. Wheelbase 1330mm.

passion pro.source_notes: Hero Passion Pro. Kerb 118kg + 50kg rider = 168kg. Wheelbase 1270mm.

ather.source_notes: Ather 450 (base variant). Kerb 111kg + 50kg rider = 161kg. Wheelbase 1278mm. Canonical copy -- mirrored in scoring_pandera's own vehicle_model_specs.json.

ola s1.source_notes: Ola S1 (base variant; Air/X/Pro variants 101-125kg kerb, 121kg used). Kerb 121kg + 50kg rider = 171kg. Wheelbase 1359mm.

chetak.source_notes: Bajaj Chetak (electric). Kerb 134kg + 50kg rider = 184kg. Wheelbase 1330mm. Distinct from the petrol/CNG 'bajaj re' three-wheeler entry above.
